briefdescription.para: Returns the complete text of a glyph sheet, reconciled against a manifest's glyphs table.

detaileddescription.para: sheetText is the existing sheet's text, or empty when no sheet exists yet. The manifest's ## glyphs table decides which cells exist in the returned sheet: a cell present in both the table and the existing sheet keeps its own width and its artwork, shifted to follow the cell; a cell absent from the table is not emitted, and its artwork goes with it. A cell new to the sheet takes the width of its codepoint count in plain cells. The cells repack in table order, in rows grouped by codepoint count, and the canvas resizes to fit them. Top-level elements that are neither a glyph group nor the guides layer pass through, and the existing background rect is resized to the canvas. The command fails on a table row that holds a reserved codepoint or more than three codepoints. The parsed existing sheet is read and never modified.

parameterdescription.para: The font family manifest, read for its glyphs, guides, colour and metrics tables.
The existing sheet's text, or empty when none exists.

simplesect.para: The complete text of the reconciled glyph sheet.
